items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So Bob Smiley pulls on his lapel and says, "Well, boy, that's what you got to do."

ctx.x: But had a valet, private valet, for Louis, but he wasn't really a valet. He was a snitch for Joe Gasser. You know. What's going on, and he was supposed to call in at certain times, you know, how many weeks or what, you know, to see what's happening with the band. And it was Bob Smiley.

So every time Sid would get up out of his seat, Smiley would come down and sit in Big Sid's seat to talk to Louis, you know, just across from him. So Big Sid was up front, standing in the stairwell, you know, looking out the highway. Come back, here's Bob Smiley sitting in his seat. Say, "Man, how many times have I told you to keep your mm out of my seat?" He say, "I oughta knock you down." So Bob Smiley pulls on his lapel and says, "Well, boy, that's what you got to do."
And he stood up and when he stood up, he went down.
